calculation.description: Medium-term price momentum scaled by trailing downside-return volatility; signal is lagged one completed day before forward-return testing. Higher values indicate stronger gains per unit downside risk.

validation.regime_notes: Only 45 valid cross-sectional dates were available under strict history and at least-8-name coverage; uncertainty is high. Recent sample includes 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-10. No pre-2025 observations were available from the retrieved aligned data.

signal_artifact.alignment: factor shifted one trading day; forward return is next close-to-close return
